sample_unit: completed questionnaires from neonatal care providers

links.outcome: Reasons neonatal decision support tools did not affect clinical care, including lack of EHR integration
links.effect: Lack of EHR integration was among the common reasons tools did not impact care, alongside lack of confidence in prediction accuracy and unhelpful predictions. Use was >90% for BiliTool and the EOS tool, 72% for Extremely Preterm Birth, 39% for BPD.
links.quote: Common reasons CDSTs did not impact clinical care included lack of electronic health record integration, lack of confidence in prediction accuracy, and unhelpful predictions.

screen.reason: Survey/needs assessment of neonatal clinicians evaluating real-world clinical utilization and barriers/facilitators of four common predictive/decision support tools.
